proposals.after: In 1855 he served under Provincial Military Commander He Chun in the recovery of Luzhou and was promoted to district magistrate.
proposals.reason: 提督 is provincial military commander (tidu), not Grand Secretary (大學士).

proposals.before: In the fifth year, he followed Grand Secretary He Chun in recovering Luzhou and was promoted to district magistrate.

proposals.before: When rebels besieged Baoqing, he marched to its relief; allied forces fought them off in a series of battles, and he was given the Mongol title Erde Muturu.
proposals.after: When rebels besieged Baoqing, he marched to its relief; allied forces fought them off in a series of battles, and he was given the title E'erdemu Baturu.
proposals.reason: 額爾德木巴圖魯 is the Manchu/Mongol Baturu honorific E'erdemu Baturu, not the clipped Erde Muturu.

proposals.before: When the main army captured Jiujiang, his merit earned him a place on the register as provincial military commander.
proposals.after: When the main army captured Jiujiang, his merit earned him a place on the register as regional commander (zongbing).
proposals.reason: 總兵 is regional commander/zongbing, not 提督 provincial military commander.

proposals.before: For repeated victories Qingji received the title Ganyong Baturu, was made provincial military commander, and given provincial commander rank.
proposals.after: For repeated victories Qingji received the title Ganyong Baturu, was promoted to regional commander (zongbing), and was given the rank of provincial military commander (tidu).
proposals.reason: 擢總兵加提督銜 is promotion to zongbing plus tidu rank, not two wordings of the same tidu office.

proposals.before: Jichang and provincial commander Cheng Daji routed him, retook Huoshan, and Jichang received provincial commander rank.
proposals.after: Jichang and regional commander Cheng Daji routed him, retook Huoshan, and Jichang received the rank of regional commander (zongbing).
proposals.reason: 總兵 and 總兵銜 are zongbing, not 提督 provincial military commander.

proposals.before: In the tenth month he fought the Nian at Runing, stormed Pingyu Stockade, took the rebel chief Chen Wen alive, and was entered on the rolls as provincial commander.
proposals.after: In the tenth month he fought the Nian at Runing, stormed Pingyu Stockade, took the rebel chief Chen Wen alive, and was entered on the rolls as regional commander (zongbing).
proposals.reason: 總兵記名 is registration as zongbing, not as 提督.

proposals.before: When Tingzhou and Liancheng fell in turn, Wencha hurried back, routed the rebels at Jinji Ridge, ambushed them along the river line, retook Liancheng, and pressed on to capture Tingzhou; he was entered on the rolls as provincial commander.
proposals.after: When Tingzhou and Liancheng fell in turn, Wencha hurried back, routed the rebels at Jinji Ridge, ambushed them along the river line, retook Liancheng, and pressed on to capture Tingzhou; he was entered on the rolls as regional commander (zongbing).
proposals.reason: 總兵記名 is registration as zongbing, not 提督.

proposals.before: When provincial commander Qin Ruhu attacked Chuzhou the rebels abandoned the city; Jinyun fell as well, and Wencha was appointed provincial commander of the Funing garrison.
proposals.after: When regional commander Qin Ruhu attacked Chuzhou the rebels abandoned the city; Jinyun fell as well, and Wencha was appointed commander of the Funing garrison (zongbing).
proposals.reason: 總兵秦如虎 and 福寧鎮總兵 are zongbing, not 提督.

proposals.after: In 1865 Governor-General Lao Chongguang ordered him to raise Hunan braves for operations toward Libo and Dushan.

proposals.after: In 1871 he was made regional commander (zongbing) of the Weining garrison and led the campaign against the Guzhou Miao.

decisions.reason: 提督 is the provincial military command, not the civil Grand Secretary office. The proposed correction accurately identifies He Chun's title.
The literal field makes the same office error: 提督 is Provincial Military Commander, not Grand Secretary.
額爾德木巴圖魯 is the honorific E'erdemu Baturu. The existing 'Erde Muturu' incorrectly divides and corrupts the title.
總兵 is a regional commander (zongbing), distinct from 提督, the provincial military commander.
擢總兵加提督銜 distinguishes promotion to zongbing from the added rank of tidu; the existing English collapses the two offices.
Both 總兵 and 總兵銜 refer to the zongbing office or rank, not the higher provincial 提督 command.
